answer_4.quote: We carried out a human survey to compare the ease of understanding and the utility of the explanations obtained by LIME and LENs. The human survey was approved by the ethics committee and the questions do not record personal information. The survey was shared with students and researchers over different universities and filled by 26 respondents, 13 with experience in Machine Learning, 10 in Computer Science and 3 in neither.
answer_4.guideline: Survey tasks included: rating ease of understanding local explanations; identifying a feature to ignore to improve the classifier; identifying the more general classifier; and rating ease of using explanations for specific purposes.
